outcome: neonatal seizures in the absence of hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE)
cohort: Newborns at 34 gestational weeks or later from the University hospitals of Örebro (1994-2013) and Uppsala (2003-2013), 40 cases with seizures and 160 controls
finding: Preterm birth was the strongest risk factor for neonatal seizures in the absence of HIE, and the findings also suggest feto-pelvic disproportion is associated with seizure occurrence.
mod_finding: Antenatal risk factors for neonatal seizures included previous cesarean section (AOR: 4.8; 1.5-15.0).
